name: growder-web-qa
description: Pruebas automatizadas Playwright para GrowderWeb con patron POM

scripts.clean:allure: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.rmSync('allure-results', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.rmSync('allure-report', { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.test:allure: npm run clean:allure && playwright test && npm run allure:generate && npm run allure:open
